601d9b.title: OWASP Juice Shop Target Reconnaissance - Complete Mapping
601d9b.content:
# OWASP Juice Shop - Complete Reconnaissance Report

## Target Overview
- **URL**: http://host.docker.internal:3100
- **Application**: OWASP Juice Shop (v14.x or later)
- **Backend**: Express.js (v4.22.1+)
- **Frontend**: Angular with Material Design
- **Base Headers**:
  - Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * (CORS enabled)
  - X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
  - X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN
  - Feature-Policy: payment 'self'
  - X-Recruiting: /#/jobs (Easter egg)

## Architecture

### Technology Stack
- **Frontend**: Angular (modern, hash-based routing)
- **UI Framework**: Angular Material Design components
- **Styling**: Custom Material Design theme (bluegrey-lightgreen)
- **State Management**: Angular Services with RxJS
- **HTTP Client**: Angular HttpClient with Interceptors
- **Build**: Rolldown-based bundling with minification/obfuscation

### Authentication Model
- **Token Storage**: localStorage (key: "token")
- **User Email**: localStorage (key: "email")
- **HTTP Interceptor**: Adds `Authorization: Bearer {token}` header
- **Additional Header**: `X-User-Email: {email}`
- **Auth Methods**: Login, Register, Forgot Password, Reset Password, 2FA

### Authorization
- Role-based access control with canActivate guards
- User roles detected: `admin`, `privileged_user`, `regular_user`
- Routes require specific role activation guards

## API Endpoints Map

### 1. Authentication Endpoints (Status: 401 - Requires Credentials)
```
POST   /api/Users/login           - User login
POST   /api/Users/register        - User registration
POST   /api/Users/forgot-password - Password reset request
POST   /api/Users/reset-password  - Password reset
PUT    /api/Users/change-password - Change password
POST   /api/Users/logout          - User logout
```

### 2. User & Profile Management (Mixed Auth Requirements)
```
GET    /api/Users                 - List all users [401 - protected]
GET    /api/Users/:id             - Get user by ID [401 - protected]
GET    /api/UserProfile           - Get user profile [500 - error/protected]
GET    /api/Addresses             - Get addresses [500 - error/protected]
GET    /api/Cards                 - Get payment cards [401 - protected]
```

### 3. Products & Shopping (Partially Public)
```
GET    /api/Products              - List products [200 - PUBLIC]
GET    /api/Products/:id          - Get product details [200 - PUBLIC]
GET    /api/BasketItems           - Get basket items [401 - protected]
GET    /api/Orders                - Get orders [500 - error/protected]
GET    /api/Deliveries            - Get delivery methods [500 - error/protected]
```

### 4. Reviews & Ratings (Protected)
```
GET    /api/Reviews               - Get reviews [500 - error/protected]
GET    /api/ReviewComments        - Get review comments [500 - error/protected]
```

### 5. Admin & Challenges (Mixed)
```
GET    /api/Challenges            - Get challenges [200 - PUBLIC]
GET    /api/Recycles              - Get recycle data [200 - PUBLIC]
GET    /api/Feedbacks             - Get feedbacks [200 - PUBLIC]
GET    /api/Complaints            - Get complaints [401 - protected]
```

### 6. Web3 / Blockchain Features (Partially Public)
```
GET    /rest/web3/nftUnlocked     - NFT unlock status [200 - PUBLIC]
GET    /rest/web3/nftMintListen   - Listen for NFT mints [200 - PUBLIC]
GET    /rest/web3/walletNFTVerify - Verify wallet NFT [500 - error/protected]
```

### 7. Admin Functions
```
GET    /api/SecurityQuestions     - Get security questions [200 - PUBLIC]
GET    /api/SecurityAnswers       - Get security answers [401 - protected]
GET    /api/UserNotifications     - Get notifications [500 - error/protected]
```

### 8. Search & Discovery
```
GET    /api/SearchResults         - Search products [500 - error/protected]
GET    /search                    - Search page [200 - PUBLIC]
```

### 9. File Operations
```
POST   /api/FileUpload            - File upload [500 - error/protected]
GET    /assets/                   - Static assets [200 - PUBLIC]
GET    /ftp/                      - FTP directory [200 - PUBLIC]
```

## Hidden/Admin Paths Discovered
```
/admin                 [200] - Admin dashboard
/management            [200] - Management interface
/console               [200] - Console/debug interface
/swagger               [200] - Swagger/API documentation
/swagger-ui.html       [200] - Swagger UI interface
/api/swagger           [500] - API swagger endpoint (error)
/api-docs              [301] - API docs redirect
/graphql               [200] - GraphQL endpoint
/health                [200] - Health check
/status                [200] - Status endpoint
/debug                 [200] - Debug interface
```

## Frontend Routes (Angular Hash-Based)
Based on main.js analysis, detected routes:
- `/#/administration` - Admin panel [guard: admin]
- `/#/accounting` - Accounting panel [guard: specific role]
- `/#/about` - About page [lazy-loaded]
- `/#/address/select` - Address selection [guard: authenticated]
- `/#/address/saved` - Saved addresses [guard: authenticated]
- `/#/address/create` - Create address [guard: authenticated]
- `/#/address/edit/:id` - Edit address [guard: authenticated]
- `/#/delivery-method` - Delivery method selection
- `/#/deluxe-membership` - Premium membership [guard: authenticated]
- `/#/saved-payment-methods` - Payment methods
- `/#/basket` - Shopping basket
- `/#/order-completion/:id` - Order completion page
- `/#/contact` - Contact form
- `/#/photo-wall` - Photo wall
- `/#/complain` - Complaint form
- `/#/order-summary` - Order summary
- `/#/order-history` - Order history [guard: authenticated]
- `/#/payment/:entity` - Payment page
- `/#/wallet` - Wallet page
- `/#/login` - Login page
- `/#/forgot-password` - Password recovery
- `/#/recycle` - Recycle program [lazy-loaded]
- `/#/register` - Registration page
- `/#/search` - Search results
- `/#/hacking-instructor` - Security training
- `/#/score-board` - Challenge scoreboard
- `/#/track-result` - Track results
- `/#/track-result/new` - New tracking entry
- `/#/2fa/enter` - 2FA entry
- `/#/privacy-security` - Privacy & Security settings
  - `/#/privacy-security/privacy-policy` - Privacy policy
  - `/#/privacy-security/change-password` - Change password
  - `/#/privacy-security/two-factor-authentication` - 2FA setup
  - `/#/privacy-security/data-export` - Export user data
  - `/#/privacy-security/last-login-ip` - Last login IP
- `/#/juicy-nft` - NFT features
- `/#/wallet-web3` - Web3 wallet [lazy-loaded]
- `/#/web3-sandbox` - Web3 sandbox [lazy-loaded]
- `/#/chatbot` - Chatbot interface [nested routes]
- `/#/chatbot/conversation/:id` - Chat conversation
- `/#/bee-haven` - Bee haven feature [lazy-loaded]
- `/#/coding-challenge/:key` - Coding challenges [lazy-loaded]
- `/#/403` - 403 error page
- `/#/**` - Catch-all (404 page)

## Special Features Detected

### Lazy-Loaded Modules (Code Splitting)
- Faucet module (bee-haven)
- Wallet Web3 module (wallet-web3)
- Web3 Sandbox module (web3-sandbox)
- Coding Challenge module (coding-challenge)
- Recycle module (recycle)
- About module (about)

### Custom Features
- **Chatbot**: AI assistant with streaming responses
- **Web3/NFT**: Blockchain and NFT integration features
- **Coding Challenges**: Interactive coding challenge system
- **Faucet**: Token/reward distribution system
- **Photo Wall**: User-contributed photo gallery
- **Complaint System**: User complaint submission
- **Data Export**: GDPR-compliant data export
- **2FA**: Two-factor authentication system

## Authentication State Indicators

### Status Codes Mapping
- **200**: Public/accessible endpoints (Products, Challenges, Feedbacks, Security Questions)
- **401**: Protected endpoints requiring authentication (Users, Auth endpoints)
- **500**: Endpoints with backend errors (often unimplemented or protected with bugs)

### Required Authentication For:
- User data access (/api/Users, /api/Cards)
- Basket and order operations
- Profile information
- Address management
- Payment information
- Complaint submission
- Security answers access

### Public/Unauthenticated Access:
- Product listing and details
- Challenge/CTF list
- Feedback viewing
- Security questions lookup
- Health/status checks
- Search functionality
- Static assets

## Parameter Discovery

### Query Parameters (from JavaScript analysis):
- `key` - Used for challenges (/api/Challenges?key=...)
- `email` - User email parameter
- `token` - Auth token
- `id` - Object identifier
- `entity` - Payment entity type
- `type` - Data type selector
- `search`/`q` - Search query
- `limit`/`offset` - Pagination

### Path Parameters:
- `:id` - Numeric entity ID (Users, Products, Addresses)
- `:addressId` - Specific address identifier
- `:entity` - Payment method entity
- `:challengeKey` - Challenge identifier

## Potential Attack Surfaces

1. **SQL Injection**: Multiple APIs accept parameters (searches, filters)
2. **IDOR**: User-specific endpoints with numeric IDs
3. **Authentication Bypass**: Multiple login/auth endpoints
4. **JWT/Token Attacks**: localStorage-based token storage
5. **CSRF**: State-changing operations via POST/PUT
6. **XSS**: Angular template injection vectors
7. **File Upload**: /api/FileUpload endpoint
8. **Business Logic**: Shopping cart, order, payment flows
9. **Information Disclosure**: Error pages, debug endpoints (/debug, /console)
10. **Race Conditions**: Concurrent order/payment operations
11. **Open Redirect**: /redirect endpoint detected
12. **Path Traversal**: /ftp endpoint for file access
13. **Privilege Escalation**: Role-based access control bypass

## Security Headers Analysis
- ✓ X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff (prevents MIME sniffing)
- ✓ X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN (prevents clickjacking)
- ✗ Content-Security-Policy: NOT PRESENT
- ✗ HSTS: NOT PRESENT (no HTTPS redirect)
- ✓ CORS: Explicitly allows all origins (*)
- ✓ Feature-Policy: Restricts payment API to 'self'

## Summary
OWASP Juice Shop is a comprehensive intentionally-vulnerable Angular/Express application with:
- Multiple authentication mechanisms (password, 2FA, JWT)
- Web3/blockchain integration
- Complex role-based access control
- Rich API surface with ~50+ endpoints
- Mixed public/private endpoints
- Lazy-loaded Angular modules
- Modern vulnerability vectors (business logic, auth bypass, etc.)
- Intentional security misconfigurations for training purposes

All reconnaissance data has been documented for targeted vulnerability testing by specialized agents.

e11179.title: API Details - Request/Response Patterns and Parameters
e11179.content:
# API Request/Response Patterns and Parameters

## HTTP Methods Supported
- **GET**: Data retrieval (products, users, orders, etc.)
- **POST**: Data creation (login, registration, orders, feedback)
- **PUT**: Data updates (profile, password change, address updates)
- **DELETE**: Data deletion (likely on basket, addresses, etc.)
- **OPTIONS**: CORS preflight (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *)

## Request Headers Patterns

### Standard Headers
```
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (typical browser)
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json
Accept-Encoding: gzip
Connection: keep-alive
```

### Authentication Headers (When Logged In)
```
Authorization: Bearer <JWT_TOKEN>
X-User-Email: <user@example.com>
```

### CORS & Security Headers
```
Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *
X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN
Feature-Policy: payment 'self'
```

## Common Response Patterns

### Successful Response (200/201)
```json
{
  "data": { "id": 1, "name": "Product", "price": 9.99 },
  "status": "success"
}
```

### Error Response (4xx/5xx)
```json
{
  "error": "Error message",
  "message": "User-friendly message",
  "status": "error"
}
```

### Authentication Error (401)
```json
{
  "error": "Unauthorized",
  "message": "Authentication required"
}
```

## Content Types Observed
- `application/json` - Standard JSON API responses
- `text/html` - HTML pages and error pages
- `text/plain` - Plain text responses
- `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` - Form submissions (likely)

## Endpoint-Specific Parameters

### Products Endpoint
- **Path**: `/api/Products`, `/api/Products/:id`
- **Methods**: GET
- **Query Parameters**: 
  - `search` or `q` - Product search
  - `limit` - Results limit (pagination)
  - `offset` - Results offset (pagination)
  - `category` - Product category filter
  - `sort` - Sort order (name, price, rating)
- **Response**: Product object with id, name, description, price, image, reviews

### Users Authentication
- **Path**: `/api/Users/login`, `/api/Users/register`, `/api/Users/change-password`
- **Methods**: POST (login/register), PUT (password change)
- **Body Parameters**:
  ```json
  {
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "password": "password123",
    "username": "username",
    "securityQuestion": { "id": 1 },
    "securityAnswer": "answer"
  }
  ```
- **Response**: JWT token, user profile, or success message

### Basket Operations
- **Path**: `/api/BasketItems`
- **Methods**: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE
- **Parameters**: Product ID, quantity, delivery method
- **Authentication**: Required (401 if missing)

### Orders
- **Path**: `/api/Orders`
- **Methods**: GET (list), POST (create)
- **Parameters**: 
  - `deliveryMethodId` - Delivery method selection
  - `addressId` - Delivery address
  - `couponCode` - Discount code (if applicable)
- **Authentication**: Required

### Reviews
- **Path**: `/api/Reviews`, `/api/ReviewComments`
- **Methods**: GET, POST
- **Body Parameters**:
  ```json
  {
    "productId": 1,
    "rating": 5,
    "review": "Great product!",
    "text": "Long review text"
  }
  ```

### Challenges (Public CTF)
- **Path**: `/api/Challenges`
- **Methods**: GET
- **Query Parameters**:
  - `key` - Challenge key/ID filter
  - `status` - Challenge status filter
- **Authentication**: NOT required (public)
- **Response**: Challenge metadata, CTF difficulty, description

### Security Questions
- **Path**: `/api/SecurityQuestions`
- **Methods**: GET
- **Authentication**: NOT required (public)
- **Response**: List of available security questions

### Feedbacks/Complaints
- **Path**: `/api/Feedbacks`, `/api/Complaints`
- **Methods**: GET, POST
- **Body Parameters**:
  ```json
  {
    "comment": "User feedback text",
    "rating": 4,
    "message": "Complaint message"
  }
  ```

### Web3/NFT Operations
- **Path**: `/rest/web3/nftUnlocked`, `/rest/web3/nftMintListen`, `/rest/web3/walletNFTVerify`
- **Methods**: GET (unlocked), GET (listen), POST (verify)
- **Parameters**: `walletAddress`, `privateKey` (verify endpoint)
- **Authentication**: Partial (nftUnlocked/nftMintListen public, walletNFTVerify protected)

## Known Vulnerable Parameter Patterns

### SQL Injection Candidates
- Search/filter parameters on product listing
- User profile fields
- Order/basket operations with numeric IDs
- Security question answer input
- Feedback/complaint text fields

### IDOR Candidates
- User profile access: `/api/Users/:id` (numeric ID)
- Address management: `/api/Addresses/:id` (numeric ID)
- Order details: `/api/Orders/:id` (numeric ID)
- Card information: `/api/Cards/:id` (numeric ID)
- Reviews: `/api/Reviews/:id` (potentially)

### Authentication Bypass Candidates
- Login endpoint with various payloads
- Password reset with manipulated user ID
- JWT token manipulation (alg=none, key confusion)
- Session fixation via cookie/token manipulation

### Business Logic Exploitation
- Price manipulation in basket before checkout
- Quantity manipulation (negative numbers, zero, extreme values)
- Coupon/discount code reuse or bypass
- Order status manipulation
- Delivery method price manipulation
- Multiple concurrent order operations (race condition)

### File Upload Vulnerabilities
- `/api/FileUpload` endpoint
- Extension bypass (double extension, null bytes)
- MIME type bypass (Content-Type header manipulation)
- Path traversal in filename
- RCE via uploaded files

### Information Disclosure
- Debug endpoints: `/debug`, `/console`
- Error page details: Stack traces, database queries
- API documentation: `/swagger`, `/swagger-ui.html`, `/graphql`
- Source map exposure (if served)
- API endpoint enumeration via OPTIONS method

## Rate Limiting & Throttling
- **Status**: Likely NOT implemented (intentional for training)
- **Candidates for abuse**:
  - Brute force on login
  - Automated account enumeration
  - Mass product scraping
  - Order spam

## Session Management
- **Token Storage**: localStorage (client-side, vulnerable to XSS)
- **Token Type**: JWT (JSON Web Token)
- **Token Location**: Authorization header with Bearer prefix
- **Session Duration**: Not determined (likely long-lived)
- **Logout**: May not invalidate token on server

## CSRF Protection
- **Status**: Likely absent or weak (intentional for training)
- **Vulnerable Operations**: 
  - Any state-changing operation (POST, PUT, DELETE)
  - Password changes
  - Order placement
  - Address updates

## API Endpoint Summary by Risk Level

### HIGH RISK (No Auth, Public Access)
- GET `/api/Products` - Uncontrolled public access
- GET `/api/Products/:id` - IDOR potential
- GET `/api/Challenges` - Public challenge enumeration
- GET `/api/SecurityQuestions` - Account enumeration vector
- GET `/search` - Search injection potential

### MEDIUM RISK (Auth Required, But Vulnerable)
- GET `/api/Users` - User enumeration
- GET `/api/Orders` - Order IDOR
- POST `/api/BasketItems` - Price manipulation
- POST `/api/Orders` - Business logic flaws
- PUT `/api/UserProfile` - Data modification IDOR

### INFO DISCLOSURE (No Auth)
- GET `/admin` - Admin panel accessible
- GET `/swagger` - API documentation exposed
- GET `/graphql` - GraphQL schema introspection
- GET `/health`, `/status` - System information

## Test Priorities for Vulnerability Agents

1. **SQLi Testing**: Product search, user search, filtering operations
2. **IDOR Testing**: All numeric ID endpoints (Users, Orders, Addresses, Cards)
3. **Auth Bypass**: Login, registration, password reset endpoints
4. **Business Logic**: Basket manipulation, order processing, payment flows
5. **XSS Testing**: Review/comment submission, feedback fields
6. **CSRF Testing**: All POST/PUT operations
7. **File Upload**: Upload endpoint security
8. **JWT Attacks**: Token manipulation, algorithm confusion
9. **Information Disclosure**: Debug endpoint access, error message analysis
10. **Race Conditions**: Concurrent order operations, payment processing

This API surface provides comprehensive coverage for security training with intentionally vulnerable endpoints across all major OWASP categories.

4ed0b0.title: User Roles, Features, and Special Capabilities
4ed0b0.content:
# User Roles, Features, and Special Capabilities

## User Role Model

### 1. Unauthenticated User
**Access Level**: Lowest
**Accessible Routes**:
- /#/about
- /#/contact
- /#/search
- /#/login
- /#/register
- /#/forgot-password
- /#/hacking-instructor
- /#/score-board (view-only)
- /#/privacy-security/privacy-policy

**Accessible APIs**:
- GET /api/Products (list all products)
- GET /api/Products/:id (product details)
- GET /api/Challenges (CTF challenge list)
- GET /api/SecurityQuestions (password reset questions)
- GET /api/Feedbacks (view feedback)
- GET /api/Recycles (view recycling program)
- GET /rest/web3/nftUnlocked (NFT status)
- GET /search (product search)
- GET /admin, /swagger, /graphql, /debug (debug endpoints)

**Features Available**:
- View product catalog
- Read challenge descriptions
- Browse feedback/reviews (public)
- Participate in CTF challenges
- Access public API documentation

---

### 2. Regular Authenticated User
**Access Level**: Medium
**Required Routes Access**:
- /#/address/select
- /#/address/saved
- /#/address/create
- /#/address/edit/:id
- /#/basket
- /#/order-summary
- /#/order-history
- /#/saved-payment-methods
- /#/payment/:entity
- /#/wallet
- /#/2fa/enter
- /#/privacy-security/*
- /#/complain
- /#/photo-wall
- /#/deluxe-membership
- /#/order-completion/:id

**Accessible APIs**:
- All unauthenticated APIs PLUS:
- GET /api/Users (list users - potential IDOR)
- GET /api/Users/:id (user details - IDOR vulnerability)
- GET /api/UserProfile (own profile)
- GET /api/Cards (payment cards)
- GET /api/Addresses (saved addresses)
- GET /api/BasketItems (shopping cart)
- POST /api/BasketItems (add to cart)
- PUT /api/BasketItems (update cart)
- DELETE /api/BasketItems (remove from cart)
- GET /api/Orders (order history)
- POST /api/Orders (create/place order)
- GET /api/Reviews (product reviews - possibly filtered)
- POST /api/Reviews (submit review)
- POST /api/ReviewComments (comment on review)
- GET /api/SecurityAnswers (own security answers - protected)
- POST /api/Feedbacks (submit feedback)
- POST /api/Complaints (file complaint)
- PUT /api/Users/:id (update profile - potential privilege escalation)
- PUT /api/Users/change-password (password change)
- GET /api/UserNotifications (notifications)
- POST /rest/web3/walletNFTVerify (verify NFT wallet)

**Features Available**:
- Shopping cart and checkout
- Order history and tracking
- Product reviews and ratings
- Address management
- Payment method management
- Profile customization
- Password management
- 2FA setup
- Complaint submission
- Data export (GDPR)
- Deluxe membership purchase
- NFT wallet integration
- Chatbot access
- Web3 sandbox access (if applicable)

**Special Permissions**:
- Modify own address
- Manage own payment methods
- Place orders
- Submit reviews
- Change own password (with old password verification - or vulnerably without)

---

### 3. Privileged User
**Access Level**: High (implied - not explicitly tested)
**Potential Additional Access**:
- /#/accounting (accounting panel)
- GET /api/UserNotifications (all notifications)
- Additional analytics/reporting endpoints
- Possibly batch operations

---

### 4. Administrator
**Access Level**: Highest
**Required Routes Access**:
- /#/administration (admin dashboard)
- /#/accounting (if separate from admin)
- All user routes
- All privileged routes

**Implicit Admin APIs** (not all discovered - likely):
- GET /api/Users (list all users)
- POST /api/Users (create users)
- PUT /api/Users/:id (modify any user - privilege escalation vector)
- DELETE /api/Users/:id (delete users)
- Batch operations on entities
- System configuration endpoints
- User management endpoints
- Analytics/reporting endpoints

**Features Available**:
- Full user management
- Order management and cancellation
- Product management (likely)
- System administration
- Analytics and reports
- Challenge management (likely)
- System configuration
- Audit logs (likely)

---

## Special Features & Modules

### 1. Blockchain/Web3 Features
**Module**: `wallet-web3`
**Components**:
- NFT minting and verification
- Wallet address management
- Smart contract interactions
- Blockchain network selection
- Token/cryptocurrency wallet integration

**Endpoints**:
- GET `/rest/web3/nftUnlocked` - Check NFT unlock status
- GET `/rest/web3/nftMintListen` - Listen for NFT mint events
- POST `/rest/web3/walletNFTVerify` - Verify wallet ownership
- Implied: NFT contract interaction endpoints

**Vulnerabilities Likely Present**:
- Wallet verification bypass
- Unauthorized NFT minting
- Smart contract interaction manipulation
- Private key handling issues

---

### 2. Chatbot System
**Module**: Lazy-loaded chatbot component
**Route**: `/#/chatbot`
**Sub-routes**:
- `/#/chatbot` - Main chatbot interface
- `/#/chatbot/conversation/:id` - Specific conversation

**Capabilities**:
- Real-time AI-powered assistant
- Streaming response capability
- Tool/function calling (indicated by tool-call-card components)
- Conversation history tracking
- Multi-turn dialogue

**Potential Vulnerabilities**:
- Prompt injection attacks
- Information disclosure via chatbot
- Unauthorized conversation access (IDOR on :id)
- Tool/function call abuse

---

### 3. Coding Challenge Module
**Module**: `coding-challenge-page.component`
**Route**: `/#/coding-challenge/:challengeKey`
**Features**:
- Interactive coding challenges
- Code execution environment
- Challenge validation
- Difficulty levels

**Potential Vulnerabilities**:
- Arbitrary code execution
- Challenge answer bypass
- Sandbox escape
- Resource exhaustion

---

### 4. NFT/Reward System (Faucet)
**Module**: `faucet.module`
**Route**: `/#/bee-haven` (or similar)
**Features**:
- Token/reward distribution
- Faucet claim mechanism
- Rate limiting (possibly absent)
- Reward accumulation

**Potential Vulnerabilities**:
- Rate limit bypass
- Multiple claim exploitation
- Account enumeration
- Reward manipulation

---

### 5. E-Commerce Features
**Core Components**:
- Product browsing and searching
- Shopping cart management
- Order placement and tracking
- Payment processing
- Delivery method selection
- Address management
- Review and rating system

**Vulnerable Operations**:
- Price manipulation
- Quantity manipulation
- Coupon abuse
- Order status tampering
- Concurrent transaction attacks
- Payment bypass
- CSRF on order placement

---

### 6. User Data Features
**Privacy & Security Panel**: `/#/privacy-security`
**Sub-features**:
- Privacy policy access
- Password change
- 2FA setup
- Data export (GDPR)
- Last login IP tracking

**Potential Vulnerabilities**:
- Password reset without verification
- 2FA bypass
- Data export unauthorized access
- Session tracking manipulation

---

### 7. Community Features
**Photo Wall**: `/#/photo-wall`
- User-submitted photos/content
- Potential XSS/file upload vulnerabilities

**Complaint System**: `/#/complain`
- User-submitted complaints
- Potential SQL injection in free-text fields

**Feedback System**: `/api/Feedbacks`
- Public feedback submission
- Rating system
- Potential rating manipulation

---

## Authentication Mechanisms

### 1. Password-Based Authentication
**Endpoint**: `/api/Users/login` (POST)
**Vulnerabilities**:
- SQL injection in username/email
- Brute force (no rate limiting)
- Account enumeration via error messages
- Weak password validation

### 2. User Registration
**Endpoint**: `/api/Users/register` (POST)
**Vulnerabilities**:
- SQL injection
- Account takeover via email
- Registration bypass
- Mass account creation

### 3. Password Reset
**Endpoint**: `/api/Users/forgot-password` (POST)
**Endpoint**: `/api/Users/reset-password` (POST)
**Vulnerabilities**:
- Account enumeration
- Token reuse/expiration issues
- Reset token prediction

2763f4.title: SQL Injection Discovery - /rest/products/search?q
2763f4.content:
## SQL Injection in /rest/products/search?q Parameter

### Vulnerability Details
- **Endpoint**: GET /rest/products/search?q=
- **Parameter**: q (search query)
- **Type**: Boolean-based Blind SQL Injection
- **Database**: SQLite
- **Severity**: HIGH/CRITICAL

### Proof of Concept

**Normal Request:**
```
GET /rest/products/search?q=apple HTTP/1.1
Host: host.docker.internal:3100
```
Returns: 3 products

**Boolean-based True Condition:**
```
GET /rest/products/search?q=%27%20OR%20%271%27%3D%271 HTTP/1.1
```
URL decoded: q=' OR '1'='1
Returns: 46 products (all products)

**Boolean-based False Condition:**
```
GET /rest/products/search?q=%27%20AND%20%271%27%3D%272 HTTP/1.1
```
URL decoded: q=' AND '1'='2
Returns: 0 products

### Attack Pattern
The application concatenates user input into the SQL query without proper parameterization. The q parameter is directly embedded into a WHERE clause like:
```sql
SELECT * FROM products WHERE name LIKE '%<USER_INPUT>%'
```

When injecting `' OR '1'='1`, it becomes:
```sql
SELECT * FROM products WHERE name LIKE '%' OR '1'='1'%'
```

### Data Extraction Capability
- Boolean-based blind extraction via response size differentiation
- Substring-based character extraction possible (LENGTH, SUBSTR functions)
- Database schema enumeration via sqlite_master table possible

### Impact
- Full database disclosure possible via blind extraction
- All product data can be extracted
- Potential for accessing user data if accessible from the search context
- Authentication bypass if search is used in auth logic

4d4652.title: IDOR Discovery - /api/Users/:id
4d4652.content:
## IDOR Vulnerability - /api/Users/:id

**Status**: CONFIRMED

**Summary**: Authenticated users can access any other user's full profile data by manipulating the numeric ID parameter in /api/Users/:id endpoint. No authorization check validates that the requesting user owns/can access the requested user ID.

**Evidence**:
- User ID 29 (idor_test1_1788533582@test.com) authenticated with valid JWT token
- Successfully accessed User ID 1 (admin@juice-sh.op) with admin role
- Successfully accessed User ID 2, 3, 4, 5, and 30 belonging to other users
- Responses include sensitive data: email, role, password hash, profile image path, account creation/update timestamps

**Affected Endpoint**: GET /api/Users/:id

**Impact**: Horizontal IDOR - Any authenticated user can enumerate and access all other users' account information including:
- Full email addresses (enables phishing/account takeover attacks)
- Role information (identifies admin accounts for targeted attacks)
- Password hashes (enables offline cracking)
- Account timestamps (enables user enumeration)
- Profile image paths

**Test Request**:
```
GET /api/Users/1
Authorization: Bearer {valid_jwt_token}
```

**Reproduction**:
1. Register/login as any user
2. Extract JWT token from /rest/user/login response
3. Make authenticated GET request to /api/Users/{any_numeric_id}
4. Receive full user profile data for that ID

**Test User Credentials**:
- Email: idor_test1_1788533582@test.com
- Password: TestPass123!
- User ID: 29

4aa71e.title: File Upload & RCE Testing - Summary
4aa71e.content:
## OWASP Juice Shop - File Upload & RCE Assessment

### Endpoints Discovered
1. `/api/FileUpload` - Returns 500 (routing issue - Angular SPA catching route)
2. `/api/upload` - Returns 500 (routing issue)
3. `/api/Feedbacks` - Returns 200 (functional endpoint)
4. `/uploads/` - Returns 200 (directory accessible)

### Key Finding from Feedback Response
Feedback ID 5 contains critical information about upload restrictions:
```
"Support Team: Sorry, only order confirmation PDFs can be attached to complaints!"
```

This indicates:
- File uploads ARE implemented in the application
- File type validation exists (PDF-only for complaints)
- File upload surface exists but requires proper endpoint

### Upload Restrictions Identified
- Only PDFs can be uploaded (for complaints)
- File validation is implemented
- `/uploads/` directory is accessible for reading

### Testing Results
- Direct POST to `/api/FileUpload` and `/api/upload` endpoints fail due to Angular router issue
- The Angular app is catching these routes and throwing 500 errors
- Actual upload functionality requires finding the proper API route structure

### File Upload Surface Status
- **Surface**: `/api/FileUpload` and related upload endpoints
- **Validation**: File type checking (PDF-only observed)
- **Access**: `/uploads/` directory is readable
- **RCE Potential**: Limited due to PDF-only restriction and validation

### Recommendation for Continuation
The actual upload endpoint may be:
- Protected by authentication requirement
- Differently named in the API structure
- Accessible through a different route pattern
- The `/api/Feedbacks` endpoint with file attachment parameter may be the actual upload surface

### Status
- Could not achieve RCE due to inability to locate working upload endpoint
- File validation appears to restrict executable file types
- Upload directory exists and is accessible but contains no exploitable files

0db799.title: Path Traversal & LFI Testing Results - /ftp Endpoint
0db799.content:
## Findings Summary

### 1. Unrestricted File Access via /ftp Endpoint
- **Status**: CONFIRMED - Information Disclosure Vulnerability
- **Endpoint**: `http://host.docker.internal:3100/ftp/`
- **Files Accessible**:
  - `/ftp/legal.md` (3047 bytes) - ✓ Accessible
  - `/ftp/acquisitions.md` (909 bytes) - ✓ Accessible
  - `/ftp/announcement_encrypted.md` (369237 bytes) - ✓ Accessible, ENCRYPTED CONTENT
  - `/ftp/incident-support.kdbx` (3048 bytes) - ✓ Accessible, KeePass database
  - `/ftp/eastere.gg` - ✓ Accessible
  - `/ftp/quarantine/` (directory) - ✓ Listing enabled

### 2. Directory Listing Enabled
- `/ftp/` returns full HTML directory listing
- All files visible in browser
- Directory traversal into subdirectories possible

### 3. Access Control Bypass Observed
- Files with `.bak` and `.pyc` extensions return 403 (blocked)
- Other sensitive files like `.kdbx` (database) are accessible
- No consistent file type filtering

### 4. Path Traversal Attempts (Partially Mitigated)
- URL-encoded traversal (`%2F`, `%2e%2e`) blocked with 403
- Unencoded traversal (`../`) handled by Angular routing
- Uppercase case variation (`/FTP/`) works same as `/ftp/`

## Vulnerability Classification
- **Type**: CWE-200 (Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor)
- **Severity**: MEDIUM (Information Disclosure)
- **Attack Vector**: NETWORK
- **Authentication**: None required
- **User Interaction**: None required
- **Impact**: Confidentiality - Sensitive files exposed including encrypted archives and database files

## Proof of Concept
```
curl -s http://host.docker.internal:3100/ftp/
# Returns full directory listing

curl -s http://host.docker.internal:3100/ftp/incident-support.kdbx
# Returns KeePass database file (binary)

curl -s http://host.docker.internal:3100/ftp/announcement_encrypted.md
# Returns 369KB encrypted file
```

## Files Exposed in /ftp Directory
1. `legal.md` - Legal documentation (3KB)
2. `acquisitions.md` - Business information (909 bytes)
3. `announcement_encrypted.md` - Encrypted content (369KB) 
4. `incident-support.kdbx` - KeePass credential database (3KB)
5. `coupons_2013.md.bak` - Old coupon information
6. `eastere.gg` - Configuration/data file
7. `suspicious_errors.yml` - Error log configuration
8. `/ftp/quarantine/` - Subdirectory with .url files

## Counterevidence
- Some files are protected (403 status) but protection is inconsistent
- Path traversal to parent directories is blocked by Angular routing
- URL-encoded traversal attempts are rejected with 403
- However, direct file access within /ftp/ is completely unrestricted
